title: Identifying brain tumor patients' subtypes based on pre-diagnostic history and clinical characteristics: a pilot hierarchical clustering and association analysis
summary: Hierarchical clustering of 67 confirmed CNS-tumor participants identified two profiles; one profile associated with lower prevalent malignancy (reported 74% reduction, p=.026). Pilot cross-sectional association, exploratory and noncausal. The result is limited to this study and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
